result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with marked zebra crosswalks and well-maintained sidewalks. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, sight lines are partially obscured by parked vehicles along the curb, and the roadway pavement shows signs of wear.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on the right side of the image may block the visibility of pedestrians for approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway, adjacent to the crosswalk

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven pavement near the drainage inlet could pose a minor trip hazard or affect vehicle braking performance.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, near the curb and storm drain

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sight lines between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the intersection and repair the area around the storm drain to ensure a smooth, predictable surface for all users.

result.summary: The intersection features modern residential development with sidewalks but lacks essential pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals. The roadway surface is degraded, and the absence of clear lane markings or crossing indicators increases risk for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to indicate where pedestrians should cross at this signalized intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated walk/don't walk signals are visible to guide pedestrians through the traffic light cycles.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven pavement in the intersection can cause tripping hazards or affect vehicle braking.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic signal infrastructure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide roadway with embedded trolley tracks and a lack of marked crossings. While sidewalks are present, they are narrow in places and obstructed by utility poles, and the overall pavement condition is poor.

hazards.name: Embedded Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks in the roadway create a tripping hazard for pedestrians and a slipping hazard, especially when wet.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and left side of the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: No designated or painted crossing areas are visible, forcing pedestrians to cross unmarked wide lanes.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are placed directly in the path of the sidewalk, narrowing the effective walking width.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-specific signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic light infrastructure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corner to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.
